project_title: Overcall — Web App (Proxy + Detection Engine + Dashboard)
context: Calm, transparent, developer-centric proxy monitoring dashboard. Overcall sits between web apps and paid APIs (OpenAI, Stripe, AWS, Anthropic, DeepSeek), logs traffic, detects wasteful usage patterns across 3 detection tiers, and quantifies real money saved.

theme_strategy.philosophy: Flat surfaces with 1px hairline borders, no gradients, no glassmorphism, no stacked shadows. Elevation reserved strictly for genuinely floating elements (dropdown menus, popovers).
theme_strategy.hierarchy_rule: One clear visual hierarchy per screen; max 4 type sizes per screen; sentence case everywhere.
color_usage_rules: Severity colors (warning, critical) are strictly reserved for flagged issue badges, severity indicators, and high-risk alerts.
Savings green (#2F7D5A / #5FB98A) is reserved strictly for projected/realized cost savings values, resolved statuses, and positive delta indicators.
Accent blue (#35507A / #7C9CC4) is used for active navigation tabs, interactive buttons, proxy endpoint copy highlights, and focus rings.
All numeric costs, token counts, request counts, response latency (ms), request IDs, and API endpoints must use JetBrains Mono font family.

sidebar.collapsible_behavior: When collapsed, shows icon + brief text label; NEVER icon-only to maintain clarity and usability.

components: Proxy status pill indicator (Online / Listening on port 8000)
Load Synthetic Dataset action trigger button
Hero Projected Monthly Savings Card: Large projected savings number (e.g., ₹24,850/mo or $310/mo) with plain-language supporting explanation line.
Trend Line Chart: Recharts smooth line chart showing Daily Cost vs Waste Over Time across active providers with customizable date ranges.
Top 3-5 Highest-Impact Issues Card: Concise plain-language summary first, expand button for technical payload & log detail.
Flat Filterable List: Filters by Provider (OpenAI, Stripe, AWS, Anthropic, DeepSeek) and Severity (Critical, Warning, Info).
Inline Expansion Rows: Expandable row showing exact HTTP endpoint, request ID, detected pattern rule, calculated waste cost, and suggested fix snippet.
Rule Tier Badges: Tier 1 Deterministic (Trustworthy), Tier 2 Threshold-based, Tier 3 Experimental (Gated, badge + confidence score).
Provider Status Cards: Connection status (Active, Inactive, Throttled), ping latency, configured token rate limits, and pricing config per model/API.
Pricing Config Modal/Drawer: Per-provider input forms to adjust token rate cost per 1M tokens or API request call cost.
Detection Rule Toggles: Toggle rules across Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3. Includes Tier 3 experimental gate with distinct badge + confidence threshold slider.
Window Threshold Inputs: Sliders and input fields for sliding time window (seconds), request spike multipliers, and retry backoff thresholds.
Currency Switch: INR (₹) / USD ($) toggle affecting all dashboard cost displays.
Proxy URL Banner: Clear copyable proxy endpoint snippet (`http://localhost:8000/v1/proxy`) with step-by-step developer integration instructions.
One-click 'Load Synthetic Dataset' button: Instantly populates 50+ realistic API logs, 12 waste issues across 3 tiers, and trend chart data.

detection_tiers.name: Deterministic (Trustworthy)
detection_tiers.badge_color: text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 dark:text-emerald-400 dark:bg-emerald-950/50 dark:border-emerald-800
detection_tiers.description: Hard rules like duplicate payload requests within 2000ms, uncompressed JSON bodies > 100KB, and 4xx/5xx retries without exponential backoff.

detection_tiers.name: Threshold-based Tunable
detection_tiers.badge_color: text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 dark:text-amber-400 dark:bg-amber-950/50 dark:border-amber-800
detection_tiers.description: Dynamic bounds like token consumption > 3.5x moving average, redundant polling loops, and unnecessary prompt context length.

detection_tiers.name: Experimental (Gated)
detection_tiers.badge_color: text-purple-700 bg-purple-50 border-purple-200 dark:text-purple-400 dark:bg-purple-950/50 dark:border-purple-800
detection_tiers.description: Predictive semantic prompt redundancy via embedding similarity, un-cached vector queries, and high-entropy request anomalies with confidence scoring.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive elements and data points MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure exact color tokens are set up in CSS variables or Tailwind classes matching user choices.
Do NOT use gradients or heavy shadows. Use flat surfaces with border-1px hairline borders (`border-[#E5E5E3]` in light mode, `border-[#2A2D34]` in dark mode).
Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric values, prices, token counts, request rates, latency numbers, and API endpoints.
Ensure sentence case across all headings, button labels, and menu items.
Maintain maximum 4 font sizes on any given screen to preserve visual hierarchy.
Ensure the sidebar when collapsed NEVER renders icon-only — keep concise labels alongside icons.
Provide a robust synthetic dataset generation handler so the dashboard can be tested immediately in empty state and full data state.
Implement currency switcher between INR (₹) and USD ($) with conversion rate calculations across all cost displays.
